page_title: MET 0-1 STR | Metz v Strasbourg 17/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Mathieu Vernice is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
90+4' Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mike Penders, who smothers the ball.
90+2' Maxime Colin (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Penders comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+2' Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' A cross into the box from Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) is cleared.
89' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
89' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Idrissa Gueye (Metz). The linesman points to the corner flag, Metz are going to take it.
86' 0 - 1 Goal! Dilane Bakwa is the provider and Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the right of the goal from close in with his head. 0:1.
85' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) forces a pass into the box, but Jonathan Fischer is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
84' Substitution. Boubacar Traore leaves the pitch and is replaced by Joseph Nduquidi (Metz).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maxime Colin (Metz) comes onto the pitch for Koffi Kouao.
83' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
80' Here is a change. Samuel Amo-Ameyaw is going off and Liam Rosenior gives the last tactical orders to Kendry Paez (Strasbourg).
80' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
77' The possession of the ball – 32:68.
73' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Jessy Deminguet (Metz) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Alpha Toure.
73' Stephane Le Mignan decides to make a substitution. Cheikh Sabaly will be replaced by Ibou Sane (Metz).
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Samir El Mourabet walks off the pitch to be replaced by Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg).
71' Rough tackle by Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
71' The ball is cleared after Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

70' A cross by Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
69' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
67' Koffi Kouao (Metz) tries to convince the referee to change his mind and receives a yellow card for dissent.
67' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle and it's Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
66' The current number of shots on goal is 0:3.

65' A huge opportunity wasted! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) produces a header from a rebound inside the six-yard box. His effort is denied by one of the defenders who is well positioned and clears the ball to safety.
62' Looks like Urie-Michel Mboula (Metz) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
62' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
61' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jessy Deminguet (Metz) was quite harsh and Mathieu Vernice didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

60' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Jonathan Fischer displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
59' Brian Madjo goes off the pitch and Idrissa Gueye (Metz) comes on.
59' Koffi Kouao (Metz) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.

56' Emanuel Emegha almost found himself in a promising position after Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
56' Strasbourg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
56' A long ball forward to Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) is intercepted. Strasbourg force a corner. They send men into the box.
55' Liam Rosenior has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) replacing Abdoul Ouattara.
53' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
53' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jonathan Fischer intercepts the ball.
51' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
49' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mathieu Vernice had an easy-decision to make.

49' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) executes a nice mid-range free kick. His effort only flies inches wide of the left post. Today is obviously not his lucky day. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
48' The referee blows his whistle as Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) was too aggressive in his challenge. Strasbourg have been awarded a free kick.
46' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

43' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
42' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
41' Brian Madjo (Metz) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
40' Half-chance! Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) plays a pass into the box, but Jonathan Fischer reacts well to snuff out the attack.
37' Good movement by Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
35' Brian Madjo (Metz) is flagged for offside.
35' A cross from Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
34' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

34' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed just over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
33' Poor challenge! Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) is penalised for tripping and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle. Metz will take a free kick.
33' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
31' The foul by Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Mathieu Vernice.

30' Koffi Kouao (Metz) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
29' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:1.
28' Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul.
26' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.

25' Strasbourg slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
24' Metz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
24' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Metz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
22' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) picks up an injury.
22' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
20' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
20' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Strasbourg will take a corner kick.
20' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
19' Sadibou Sane (Metz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul.
18' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
16' Brian Madjo (Metz) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.

14' Brian Madjo (Metz) gets free in the box and latches onto a good cross, but somehow he sends the ball narrowly wide of the right post from the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
14' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) commits a rough challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
11' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
10' The corner is swung in but Strasbourg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

10' Jonathan Fischer makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom right corner. It will be a corner kick for Strasbourg.
10' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
9' Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Strasbourg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
8' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) commits a rough foul. Mathieu Vernice stops the game and makes a call.
5' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
4' Brian Madjo (Metz) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
3' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will take a throw-in.
2' Jonathan Fischer (Metz) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Metz will have the kick-off.
Mathieu Vernice was nominated as the referee for this game.
